verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a public REST API, let alone one with UI parity. The only nearby items do not establish the capability. 'Build custom integrations' (docs-30) is a vague marketing line, the official MCP server is a separate capability, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Under the partial-credit rules, adjacent features and claims from other stories cannot stand in for documented API coverage of UI actions.
